system.description:
You send your skin rippling into baggy, sagging folds, masking your features and hollowing little pockets of withered flesh in which to hide your possessions.

Reshaping your flesh takes a full turn of effort and the expenditure of one Blood Trait. For the rest of the scene, or for the next full hour, your features are rendered unrecognizable and you can conceal up to two objects of jacket or smaller concealment class within the folds. The bulges may be spotted if your skin is otherwise unmarred, or discovered in a pat-down search.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
